strategy.summary: Prepare Mini-Me Hurryup or Sub-Drill, then start Fat Bastard Multiball so four-ball play protects its repeated shots. Start all six main modes for Virtucon Multiball and complete all six for Moonbase Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Six main modes
quickInfo.summary: Repeated major shots start Mini-Me, Fat Bastard, Frickin' Laser, Time Machine, Sub-Drill, and Henchmen; solid inserts mark completed modes.

quickInfo.name: Fat Bastard Multiball
quickInfo.summary: The fourth toilet-ramp shot starts four-ball play; make each of the six major shots four times to complete it.

quickInfo.name: Time Machine Multiball
quickInfo.summary: The fourth Time Machine shot starts two-ball play; make all six major shots once to relight the set.

quickInfo.name: Mojo Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Spell MOJO, hit Dr. Evil ten times, then clear the six major shots and collect the Time Machine Super Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Virtucon and Moonbase
quickInfo.summary: Starting all six main modes lights Virtucon Multiball, while completing all six lights Moonbase Multiball.

steps.text: Use the opening save to test the toilet ramp, Mini-Me spinner, Time Machine, outer ramps, loops, Dr. Evil target, and their returns.
Shoot the toilet ramp three times, leaving Fat Bastard Multiball one shot from starting.
Start Mini-Me Hurryup at the spinner or Sub-Drill by completing both outer ramps four times within its timer.
Shoot the toilet ramp again to start Fat Bastard Multiball. Make each of the six major shots four times; the fourth hit on each scores its Super Jackpot.
modeNotes: Fat Bastard Multiball: The fourth toilet-ramp shot starts four-ball play with a generous ball save. Each major shot needs four hits to finish the mode.
Mode stack: Mini-Me and Sub-Drill can remain active during this multiball, and their timers pause while multiball runs.

steps.text: After multiball, start the remaining main modes from the safest major shots. Finish a mode until its five inserts are solid before treating it as complete.
After all six modes have started, play Virtucon Multiball. Repeat completed-mode shots for double jackpots; complete the normal six-shot set to relight it.
Complete all six main modes to light Moonbase Multiball.

fallback.title: Time Machine Multiball
fallback.when: Use this when the toilet-ramp return is unsafe but the Time Machine entry and release are controlled.

steps.text: Shoot the Time Machine four times to start two-ball play.
Make each of the six lit major shots once for a Jackpot.
Complete all six to relight the set while two balls remain.
After returning to one ball, switch to another unstarted main mode.

alternatives.title: Mojo Multiball
alternatives.when: Use this when the MOJO standups and Dr. Evil target are safer than either ramp multiball route.

steps.text: Spell MOJO at the two left standups to start two-ball play.
Hit Dr. Evil ten times to lower him and light the six major shots.
Clear the six shots, then shoot the Time Machine for the Super Jackpot.
Repeat the Dr. Evil and six-shot cycle while two balls remain.
Start Mini-Me, Fat Bastard, Frickin' Laser, Time Machine, Sub-Drill, and Henchmen.
Start Virtucon Multiball after all six modes have begun.
Finish every main mode so all five inserts at each major shot are solid.
Start Moonbase Multiball after all six modes are complete.

techniques.name: Completion tracking
techniques.instruction: Use the solid mode inserts to avoid spending controlled shots on an already completed mode.

cautions.issue: Each main mode has specific completion rules that can be missed if only its start shot is repeated.
cautions.response: Read the lit objectives and finish the current mode before qualifying another route.

cautions.issue: No new main mode can start during a multiball.
cautions.response: Start Mini-Me or Sub-Drill before Fat Bastard; do not leave an unstarted mode one shot away and expect to add it during multiball.

cautions.issue: A completed Time Machine mode no longer provides its single-ball scoring save.
cautions.response: Treat later Time Machine shots as normal dangerous ramp shots and do not expect an automatic relaunch.

cautions.issue: Mini-Me, Time Machine, and left-ramp switches can fail to register cleanly.
cautions.response: Watch the inserts and display for confirmed progress instead of assuming that every physical shot counted.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm the installed CPU 2.01 and display A2.00 revisions, tournament settings, ball count, Extra Ball conversion, and mode or multiball difficulty.
Check mode timers, ball-save durations, and whether all six mode-start and completion inserts register correctly.
Test the toilet ramp, Time Machine entry and release, Mini-Me spinner, outer ramps, laser cannon, Austin scoop, and Dr. Evil target.
strategy.simpleOverview: Austin Powers cannot start a new main mode during Multiball. Leave Fat Bastard one toilet-ramp shot from starting, begin Mini-Me Hurryup or Sub-Drill first, then shoot the toilet ramp and use four-ball play to finish the running mode.
strategy.overview: Starting all six main modes lights Virtucon Multiball in Austin Powers; completing all six lights Moonbase Multiball. Prepare Fat Bastard, start Mini-Me or Sub-Drill before it, then use four-ball play for the six major-shot sets. Finish the remaining modes from their safest starts, and use Time Machine or Mojo when either qualification is already close.
machineSetup: Confirm the installed CPU 2.01 and display A2.00 revisions, tournament settings, ball count, Extra Ball conversion, and mode or multiball difficulty.
Check mode timers, ball-save durations, and whether all six mode-start and completion inserts register correctly.
Test the toilet ramp, Time Machine entry and release, Mini-Me spinner, outer ramps, laser cannon, Austin scoop, and Dr. Evil target.
